meta.title: Tibyan Kids
meta.description: A personalized growth platform for Muslim children.

hero.sub: Start at your child's level, then guide them word by word through short challenges, with stories for each child and a pet who loves to see them learn.
hero.altAsia: {asia}, wearing glasses, a navy hijab and a space suit, standing beside {sham} on the moon
hero.altSham: {sham}, wearing a lavender hijab and space suit, standing on the moon

worlds.label: Five learning worlds

quran.subject: Quran
quran.name: Moonlight Observatory
quran.desc: A calm, focused space for recitation, memorisation and understanding, guided by a teacher.

arabic.subject: Arabic language
arabic.name: Letter Galaxy
arabic.desc: From first letters to confident reading, writing and speaking, through stories, songs and games.
arabic.b2: Reading and vocabulary that grow with age

akhlaq.subject: Character (Akhlaq)
akhlaq.name: Coral Sunrise
akhlaq.desc: Kindness, honesty, gratitude and respect, practised through real-life missions.
akhlaq.b2: Stories of the Prophets and Companions
akhlaq.b3: Missions to try at home with family

faith.subject: Faith (Iman)
faith.name: Faith Nebula
faith.desc: The foundations of belief, explained gently and with love, so children understand what they believe and why.
faith.b1: The pillars of Islam and iman, made simple
faith.b2: Wudu, salah and daily duas, step by step
faith.b3: Stories from the life of the Prophet ﷺ

future.subject: Future skills
future.name: Star Quest
future.desc: Thinking, creating and working together: practical skills for a changing world, taught with the same values.
future.b2: Digital safety and healthy screen habits
future.b3: Teamwork, presenting and creative projects, in Arabic and English

worlds.keys: Learning worlds. Use the left and right arrow keys to move between worlds.

preview.title: Step inside your child's universe
preview.sub: The app grows with your child. Choose an age band to see what they see at each stage.
preview.caption: This is what your child sees.

explorer.name: Little Explorer
explorer.text: Bright, playful and picture-led. Short lessons, big star rewards and plenty of encouragement for every small win.
explorer.b1: Letters and sounds through songs and games
explorer.b3: Mostly icons, so very little reading is needed
explorer.aria: App preview for ages {range}: big planets, star rewards and a meter showing how many meals their pet has had today.

navigator.name: Star Navigator
navigator.text: More reading and more independence. Streaks, constellation maps and team challenges add a sense of strategy.
navigator.b3: Daily streaks and a friendly team league
navigator.aria: App preview for ages {range}: a constellation map of lessons, a daily streak and a team league table.

captain.name: Space Captain
captain.text: Feels like a premium app, never babyish. A calmer design, deeper content and progress shown as goals and charts.
captain.aria: App preview for ages {range}: a weekly focus-time goal, a progress chart and mastery bars for each subject.

how.title: Getting started takes a few minutes
how.s1t: Sign up as a parent in a few minutes and add your child.
how.s2t: A short, child-friendly assessment helps us find the right starting level for your child.
how.s3t: Your child joins live classes and practises between them in the app.
how.s4t: Every challenge your child finishes feeds their pet and keeps it healthy.

pet.title: Every challenge is a meal
pet.text: Each stage your child completes feeds their space pet. Keep learning and it stays healthy, happy and by their side. Stop for too long and it gets hungry.

final.title: Ready for lift-off?
final.sub: Join the crew and watch your child light up. Creating your parent account takes a few minutes.

footer.tag: Arabic, Quran, character, faith and future skills for children aged {range}.
footer.note: Child safety and privacy: we never show ads or sell personal data. Children's accounts are created and managed by parents.

landing.metaDesc: Joyful lessons in Arabic and English, Quran, character, faith and future skills for children aged {range}, in a safe, ad-free world of planets and stars. Parents follow every step.
landing.petAlt: Their learning pet, a small purple space creature, happy and well fed
